7,722 likes, 111 comments - googlegemini on October 30, 2026: "Build custom skills, connect your favorite apps, and tackle more with Gemini 4 Argon. Swipe for a recap of our latest Gemini Drops ➡️

Gemini 4 Argon breaks down complex tasks step by step to help you build everything from polished decks to interactive web apps and 3D models. 🚀

Google Antigravity brings an agentic coding interface straight into the Gemini app for Mac. 💻

Use a simple keyboard shortcut to summarize docs, brainstorm ideas, and draft content right on your PC. 🖥️

Save your most-used instructions once and run them endlessly, so you can skip the repetitive prompting and jump straight to the results. 💾

With your permission, Gemini can reference your saved places and search history in Maps alongside your Calendar events to surface personalized recommendations for your day. 📍

Just type @ Gemini Notebook to add content to a notebook, ask grounded questions and more. 📓

Connect your favorite everyday apps and services in your settings to plan, design, and organize without switching tabs. 📱

Expand to full screen to type edits directly, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine your files. 📁

Explore topics in the student hub from the Silk Road to jet engines and quasars through interactive visual layers. 🔍

Customize your genre, track length, and vocal or instrumental style, or use ready-made templates to jumpstart your sound. 🎶

Share your avatar in Gemini with friends and tag each other in prompts to co-star in images and videos together. 👯".

1,431 likes, 120 comments - google on October 27, 2026: "Students, time to lock in for exams 🔒📚 Save this post to keep these Google Search study hacks handy:

📄 Turn your notes into PDFs
1️⃣ Head to AI Mode and tap the ➕ button
2️⃣ Select “Add files” to upload your notes
3️⃣ Search “turn my notes into a pdf”

📝 Make a practice quiz from your notes
1️⃣ Open AI Mode and tap the ➕ button
2️⃣ Select “Add files” to upload your study materials
3️⃣ Search “make a quiz using my notes”

🌌 Create interactive visuals
1️⃣ Go to AI Mode
2️⃣ Search “create an interactive visual of [topic]”
3️⃣ Adjust the sliders to see complex concepts come to life".
